## Lanseq company classification
Disabled by default. Configure your own Apify Header Auth on all three HTTP nodes. Read README, review build and budget, replace synthetic input, then enable executeModelCalls.

One run at a time, 20 records/run. Partial/failed batches stop further submission. POST transport errors require manual inspection of Apify Runs before retry.
